reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 8 points better, in a game of about 222 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Grizzlies (confidence).
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 195 and 243 total points.
